headline.family_guess: serif display (Playfair/Georgia-like) mixed with a rounded sans for emphasis words
headline.size_rel: large, 2-4 words per screen, stacked left-aligned

caption.family_guess: small serif label, sometimes handwritten-italic for accent words (e.g. 'you', 'stack a')

card_label.size_rel: small, dark pill/card with white text

layout.host_pos: center-frame, chest-up, seated at desk with warm wood bookshelf background, boom mic in shot
layout.safe_zones: top ~10% and bottom ~10% kept clear on diagram screens; host frames use full bleed
layout.caption_pos: headline text upper-left third on diagram/b-roll screens; no burned captions over host frames (spoken word only)

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: 6-8 (fast diagram cuts, slower ~2-3 on host talking-head holds)
transitions: funnel/pipe morph (upwork logo scanning into keyword)

themeable: accent2 (mascot/brand color) can be swapped per content topic
card_fill dark-green cards are a reusable pill/label component, color themeable
bg cream can shift lighter/darker per brand
host framing + bookshelf backdrop is fixed per creator (not themeable across clones)
quadrant/funnel/tree diagram shapes are reusable structure, colors themeable
